AIRI portal Wins Better together People Halloween
Hero story
Dev Team
AIRI's new client portal puts every call in the customer's hands
AIRI is Answering Legal's own AI receptionist — built in-house and trained on more than four million real calls to answer phones, take messages, and capture new leads around the clock. In October, the Dev Team released the AIRI Client Portal: a private website where any business using AIRI can sign in and see every call AIRI answered for them, complete with details and the recording.
Before the portal, a business that needed the record of a call had to ask Answering Legal staff to dig it up. Now customers find it themselves, at any hour — and they can check the month's minutes and charges in the same place. Staff spend less time fielding record requests, and because customers and account managers now look at the same numbers, any billing question starts from common ground.

Behind the release
The Dev Team also settled into a steady release rhythm, shipping AIRI updates on October 13, 20, and 27 — each with a written test plan for the testers, and every proposed change now required to state its risk before it goes in. On the customer side, the Customer Success Team reported more customers switching to AIRI to lower their overhead and cut down on spam calls.
From Diego T., Dev Team — learn more about AIRI at answeringservice.ai
Wins across the company
Leadership · Community honor
Brooke Shatles honored at the Celebrate St. James gala
Founder and CEO Brooke Shatles was named a 2026 honoree at An American Overture, the gala for Celebrate St. James. The nonprofit preserves the town's history and brings the arts to the community, and it is turning the historic Calderone Theatre into the St. James Community Arts Center. Organizers recognized Brooke as a volunteer, supporter, and donor since the group's earliest days. She was honored alongside local leaders including Assemblyman Michael J. Fitzpatrick and Legislator Sal Formica, with Answering Legal's C-level executives in attendance. Answering Legal and Ring Savvy were also Overture Sponsors of the evening.
St. James “has always held a special place in my heart.”— Brooke Shatles
Quality Control Team
QC officially went chat-first
The Quality Control Team — the group that reviews call quality and backs agents up in real time — officially became a chat-focused department in October. Most of its support now runs through Clask, the live chat that lets an agent ask QC for help mid-call without ever putting the caller on hold. Manager Annisha F. credited the team's quick turnaround and how fast it adapted to the new way of working.
Cold Caller Team
Nine of eleven cold callers hit quota
The Cold Caller Team — the reps who phone prospective customers and hand qualified leads to the sales team — saw 9 of its 11 active callers reach their monthly quota, with several setting personal bests. Edward F. led the floor with 161-plus leads and a personal-record five paid accounts. The team also sent more Answering Legal leads this month than in recent months, alongside its continued push for sister brand Ring Savvy.
Human Resources Team · Staffing
The holiday schedule is locked in
Answering Legal never closes. Its phones are answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, holidays included. That makes the holiday schedule one of the biggest puzzles of the year, and Jean R. solved it in October. After agents and supervisors submitted their shift preferences, Jean built the modified schedules for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day, so every call gets answered and the team knows its holiday plans well ahead of time.
Better together
Feature story
Marketing Team × Sales
The website started booking its own sales meetings
The Marketing Team rebuilt the company website into an appointment engine. Law firms that sign up now land on new "Talk to Sales" pages — pages where a prospect picks a time and books a call with a sales rep on the spot, instead of waiting to be called back. Tyler T. designed the pages and the new sales materials behind them.
Marketing also produced an RFP packet — the document a firm uses to compare vendors before choosing one — so prospects arrive at their meeting already sold on the service. Nick W. credited VP of Sales Ben S. for working side by side with Marketing to raise lead quality during a record year of sign-ups and paid accounts.

Cold Caller Team × Sales
Same room, more leads
The Cold Caller Team moved into the same room as the sales team this month. In their first full week side by side, the cold callers put up 320 leads — and Jake W. of Cold Caller leadership credited the whole room, saying the team is clearly benefiting from hearing the sales reps at work.

Our people
Department spotlight
The Support Team
Support kept the queue light and the customers happy
The Support Team is the first stop when a customer needs help — answering questions and working through tickets, the help requests customers send in. In October, the team kept that ticket queue light and its customers happy all month long.
What set the month apart was how the team worked together. Every member stepped up to the plate, stayed eager to learn, and kept asking questions — rockstar collaboration that showed exactly how a team that works as one builds a successful department. Teamwork makes the dream work.

Human Resources Team · Halloween party
Mummies, candy corn, and one very well-wrapped Waldo
On October 30, HR's Halloween party took over the parking lot. Skeletons, an inflatable alien, a lobster, Nemo, and Mike Wazowski turned out under the tents, then squared off in a toilet-paper mummy-wrap race, a candy-corn-with-chopsticks challenge, cornhole, and archery. The giant spider web and window clings were courtesy of Cali G. — HR's Jean R. said her window cling placement "was on point!"
Watch the Halloween party video →
Ring Savvy · Giving back
A Halloween comedy night for a new house on Long Island
Ring Savvy, Answering Legal's sister brand for businesses outside the legal industry, was a Laugh Out Loud sponsor of the Halloween Comedy Show fundraiser benefiting Ronald McDonald House Charities of Long Island, with the Ring Savvy and Answering Legal seal on the sponsor board. The organization gives families a home away from home while their children receive medical care, so they can stay close during some of life's hardest moments. It is now planning a new Ronald McDonald House in Stony Brook, and Ring Savvy said it looks forward to getting even more involved as that house comes to life.
